what: heatr3d cross-engine confirmation of the phase-2 dopant peak-RELOCATION. NOT a shippability claim (the 0.40x shaped map is is_shippable=FALSE, over ceiling on both engines). Purpose: independently bound how dopant-dependent the ceiling is, to quantify the Stage B drive-headroom margin (Delta_dopant) across engines, not just in dolfinx.
geometry: make_geometry square diam=0.020 zspan=grid.L, n=64, standard 60mm chamber (like-for-like with verify_square_stageA_heatr3d.json)

relocation_C.note: shaped minus uniform at the same drive/chamber; engine offset (~4-6C hotter heatr3d) largely cancels in the difference, so the +11/+13 relocation agreement is the robust cross-engine quantity

implication: both engines confirm FGM dopant shaping is NOT thermally neutral: it concentrates heat and raises the peak ~11-13C at 0.40x. The Stage B drive-headroom margin Delta_dopant should use the more conservative ~13C (round up for safety) to be robust across engines.
engines: heatr3d_native voxel FDM (n=64) vs solve3d dolfinx FEM tet
